# partiteai_boundary (Data Source)

Boundary data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource identifier

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `modifications` (Attributes List) The modifications, made in order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modifications))
- `name` (String) Resource name
- `report_only` (Boolean) Every rule reports what it would refuse rather than refusing it, and no modification is made
- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules, checked in order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
- `warnings` (List of String) What is likely wrong with the boundary

<a id="nestedatt--modifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modifications`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action the modification sets things on
- `name` (String) Name of the modification
- `set_arguments` (Map of String) Tool call arguments to set, each name with a CEL expression that gives its value
- `set_tags` (Map of String) Tags to set, each name with a CEL expression that gives its values
- `set_tracing` (String) A CEL expression that gives whether the conversation is traced
- `when` (String) CEL expression that decides whether the modification applies


<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action the rule checks
- `effect` (String) `DENY` or `ASK`
- `message` (String) Told to whoever the rule refuses, or asks to approve
- `name` (String) Name of the rule
- `report_only` (Boolean) The rule reports what it would refuse rather than refusing it
- `when` (String) CEL expression that decides whether the rule applies
